parent_objective: design an early-stopped multi-seed frozen-actor head-only repeat after M646 validation overfit

public_gates: save best validation head rather than final epoch only
verify actor checksum unchanged for every seed
keep actor coupling and promotion blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not train in design milestone
do not update actor parameters in later repeat
do not treat source-heldout as private evidence
do not ignore wrong-history source weakness
hypothesis: A best-validation multi-seed frozen-head repeat can preserve the M646 learnability result while controlling head-level overfit before any actor-coupling design.
success_criteria: design specifies seeds and early-stopping rule
failure_criteria: design treats head-only result as promotion evidence
decision_rule: M648 passes as design only if it defines a best-validation multi-seed head-only repeat and keeps actor coupling blocked.
